name: ztpf_author_action_like_another
why: "Make me a record that looks like this one, but does X." The authoring
ask across metadata sources, templates and actions -- the user supplies a
GOAL and an EXEMPLAR, never a schema, and expects the conventions of the
exemplar to carry: the same Category/Type pairing, the same
`{{input.*}}` parameter style, an output template in the house shape.
The mounted record is a real `Remote CLI` action whose script greps an
interface. The catalog already holds a DeviceDB loopback action, so a
grounded answer can copy a real convention instead of inventing one.
This is the persona that must NOT reach for playbook-building: the
deliverable is a RECORD in this module.

steps.user: Make me an action like this one, but for showing the routing table on a device.
